test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The locusts have attacked the crops in Western India.

options.text: The crops in Western India have been attacked by the locusts.
The crops in Western India have attacked the locusts.
The locusts in Western India have been attacked by the crops.
The crops in Western India were attacked by the locusts.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The crops in Western India have been attacked by the locusts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Active Voice describes a sentence where the subject performs the action stated by the verb. While in the Passive Voice subject is acted upon by the verb.
 
• The given sentence is in the **active **form and in the** Present Perfect** tense.
 
• The structure of active voice in Present Perfect = Subject + has/have + past participle (V3) + object__
 
• The structure of passive Voice in Present Perfect = __ Object + has/have + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject)__
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

Thus the passive voice will be: *The crops in Western India have been attacked by the locusts.*
